entries.name: Circuit breaker
entries.summary: A switching device that can interrupt a circuit, with specified fault-interruption capability.

entries.name: Disconnector
entries.summary: A switching device providing an electrical isolation function.

entries.name: Load-break switch
entries.summary: A switch with a specified capability to make and break normal load current.

entries.name: Earthing switch
entries.summary: A switch used to connect an identified circuit section to earth.

entries.name: Fuse
entries.summary: An overcurrent protective element that interrupts a circuit by melting its fuse link.

entries.name: Busbar
entries.summary: A common conductive connection distributing power to connected circuits.

entries.name: Power transformer
entries.summary: Equipment transferring electrical power between winding circuits.

entries.name: Three-phase motor
entries.summary: An electrical motor load connected to its switching and protective equipment.

entries.name: Capacitor
entries.summary: A capacitive component or bank identified with its circuit function and ratings.

entries.name: AC circuit breaker
entries.summary: The device-function number identifying an AC circuit breaker.

entries.name: Line switch
entries.summary: The device-function number used for a line-switching or disconnecting device in its documented application.

entries.name: Switchgear panel
entries.summary: An equipment reference for general arrangement drawings, linked to manufacturer resources.

entries.name: Switchboard
entries.summary: A distribution assembly represented by a generic envelope in an arrangement drawing.

entries.name: Ring main unit
entries.summary: A secondary-distribution switchgear assembly with a selected combination of switching functions.

entries.name: Single-pole circuit breaker
entries.summary: A circuit breaker interrupts one pole of a circuit.

entries.name: Thermal circuit breaker
entries.summary: A thermal circuit breaker uses a temperature-responsive trip mechanism to detect sustained overload.

entries.name: Thermal-magnetic circuit breaker
entries.summary: A thermal-magnetic breaker combines overload response with a magnetic response to high current.

entries.name: Current-limiting circuit breaker
entries.summary: A current-limiting breaker reduces the fault-current peak and energy passed to downstream equipment within its documented operating range.

entries.name: Residual-current circuit breaker
entries.summary: An RCCB operates on residual current and has no integral overcurrent protection.

entries.name: Residual-current breaker with overcurrent protection
aliases: residual-current circuit breaker with overcurrent protection
entries.summary: An RCBO combines residual-current operation with overcurrent protection in one device.

entries.name: Circuit breaker with undervoltage release
entries.summary: A breaker undervoltage release changes the breaker operating condition when its control voltage falls below the specified range.

entries.name: Circuit breaker with electronic trip unit
entries.summary: A breaker electronic trip unit measures current and applies configured protection functions.

entries.name: Miniature circuit breaker
entries.summary: An MCB is a compact low-voltage circuit breaker commonly used for final circuits and auxiliary supplies.

entries.name: Moulded-case circuit breaker
entries.summary: An MCCB is a low-voltage circuit breaker built in a moulded insulating case.

entries.name: Air circuit breaker
entries.summary: An ACB is a low-voltage circuit breaker using air as its interrupting medium.

entries.name: Additional circuit-breaker pole
entries.summary: An additional pole is a separately drawn part of a multipole circuit breaker.

entries.name: Switch-disconnector
entries.summary: A switch-disconnector combines operational switching with an isolation function.

entries.name: Lockable disconnector
entries.summary: A lockable disconnector has a mechanism that can retain the isolation position under a specified locking arrangement.

entries.name: Lockable switch-disconnector
entries.summary: A lockable switch-disconnector combines an isolation-capable switching device with a documented locking provision.

entries.name: Three-position disconnector
entries.summary: A three-position disconnector selects between two paths and an intermediate position.

entries.name: Semiconductor power switch
entries.summary: A semiconductor power switch controls a power path electronically.

entries.name: Unidirectional semiconductor power switch
entries.summary: A unidirectional semiconductor switch has a specified direction for its power conduction or control behaviour.

entries.name: Two-pole power switch
entries.summary: A two-pole power switch operates two circuit conductors through a common device.

entries.name: Disconnector auxiliary NO contact
entries.summary: A normally-open disconnector auxiliary contact provides a separate indication or permissive circuit associated with the disconnector mechanism.

entries.name: Disconnector auxiliary NC contact
entries.summary: A normally-closed disconnector auxiliary contact is closed in the documented unactuated reference state.

entries.name: Fused switch
entries.summary: A fused switch combines a switching function with fuse protection.

entries.name: Fuse-switch
entries.summary: A fuse-switch uses a fuse-link or fuse carrier as part of its moving switching contact system.

entries.name: Additional fused-switch pole
entries.summary: An additional fused-switch pole represents another conductor of a common multipole device.

entries.name: General-purpose full-range fuse
entries.summary: A gG fuse-link provides full-range overcurrent protection for general applications within its documented ratings.

entries.name: Motor short-circuit fuse
entries.summary: An aM fuse-link is a partial-range fuse used for motor-circuit short-circuit protection.

entries.name: Motor full-range fuse
entries.summary: A gM fuse-link is a motor-circuit fuse with a characteristic chosen for starting and fault conditions.

entries.name: Single-phase two-winding transformer
entries.summary: A single-phase two-winding transformer transfers energy between separate primary and secondary windings.

entries.name: Electrostatically screened transformer
entries.summary: A screened transformer includes a documented screen between windings.

entries.name: Three-winding transformer
entries.summary: A three-winding transformer couples three windings through its magnetic system.

entries.name: Adjustable-ratio transformer
entries.summary: An adjustable-ratio transformer includes a documented means of varying its voltage ratio.

entries.name: Single-phase autotransformer
entries.summary: A single-phase autotransformer uses a winding portion shared electrically by its input and output circuits.

entries.name: Three-phase star autotransformer
entries.summary: A three-phase star-connected autotransformer has electrically shared winding portions arranged in a three-phase star connection.

entries.name: Star-delta transformer
entries.summary: A star-delta transformer connects one winding set in star and the other in delta.

entries.name: Delta-star transformer
entries.summary: A delta-star transformer provides a delta-connected winding and a star-connected winding.

entries.name: Delta-delta transformer
entries.summary: A delta-delta transformer uses delta-connected windings on both sides.

entries.name: Star-star transformer
entries.summary: A star-star transformer has star-connected windings on both sides.

entries.name: Star-zigzag transformer
entries.summary: A star-zigzag transformer combines a star-connected winding set with a zigzag-connected set.

entries.name: Star-star-delta three-winding transformer
entries.summary: A star-star-delta transformer includes two star-connected winding sets and a delta tertiary winding.

entries.name: Delta winding connection
entries.summary: A delta winding connects three phase windings in a closed loop.

entries.name: Open-delta winding connection
entries.summary: An open-delta arrangement uses an incomplete delta connection for a specified transformer or measurement purpose.

entries.name: Star winding connection
entries.summary: A star winding joins one end of each phase winding at a common point.

entries.name: Star winding with accessible neutral
entries.summary: An accessible-neutral star winding brings the common star point to a documented terminal.

entries.name: Zigzag winding connection
entries.summary: A zigzag winding interconnects portions of phase windings in a specified arrangement.

entries.name: Three-phase power-factor capacitor
entries.summary: A three-phase capacitor assembly provides a documented reactive-power function connected to the power circuit.

entries.name: Reactor
entries.summary: A reactor is an inductive component used for a documented power-circuit purpose.

entries.name: Iron-core reactor
entries.summary: An iron-core reactor uses a documented magnetic core to provide its inductive characteristic.

entries.name: Gapped-core inductor
entries.summary: A gapped-core inductor includes a documented air gap in its magnetic circuit.

entries.name: Adjustable-core inductor
entries.summary: An adjustable-core inductor varies its documented inductive characteristic through a magnetic adjustment.

entries.name: Single-phase AC motor
entries.summary: A single-phase AC motor represents a load supplied from a documented single-phase source.

entries.name: Single-phase motor with fan
entries.summary: A single-phase motor with an associated fan identifies the driven function as well as the electrical load.

entries.name: Three-phase AC motor
entries.summary: A three-phase AC motor is a load supplied from three documented phases.

entries.name: Three-phase motor with fan
entries.summary: A three-phase motor with fan identifies an electrically driven ventilation or cooling load.

entries.name: Wound-rotor induction motor
entries.summary: A wound-rotor induction motor includes a rotor winding arrangement with documented external connections.

entries.name: Three-phase synchronous motor
entries.summary: A synchronous motor operates with a documented synchronous relationship to the electrical supply.

entries.name: DC motor
entries.summary: A DC motor represents a documented DC electrical load whose armature and any field winding arrangements need to be identified.

entries.name: Permanent-magnet DC motor
entries.summary: A permanent-magnet DC motor uses a permanent magnetic field rather than a separately connected field winding.

entries.name: Series-excited DC motor
entries.summary: A series-excited DC motor connects its documented field winding in series with the armature circuit.

entries.name: Separately excited DC motor
entries.summary: A separately excited DC motor has a documented field circuit supplied separately from the armature circuit.

entries.summary: An air circuit breaker interrupts a low-voltage power circuit and occupies a substantial assembly compartment.

entries.summary: A moulded-case breaker combines circuit switching and overcurrent protection in an insulated case.

entries.name: Miniature circuit breaker
entries.summary: A miniature breaker is a compact protective device commonly arranged in rows on a rail or distribution-board support.

entries.name: Residual-current circuit breaker
entries.summary: An RCCB detects residual current and opens its associated circuit, with its function specified independently of overcurrent protection.

entries.name: Motor-protection circuit breaker
entries.summary: A motor-protection breaker provides switching and specified motor-circuit protective functions.

entries.name: Switch disconnector
entries.summary: A switch disconnector provides the specified switching and isolation function for a power circuit.

entries.name: Fuse-switch disconnector
entries.summary: A fuse-switch assembly combines a switching arrangement with replaceable fuses.

entries.name: Fuse holder
entries.summary: A fuse holder supports and connects a replaceable fuse selected for the circuit.

entries.name: AC line reactor
entries.summary: A line reactor is an inductive device placed in a power circuit for a specified application.

entries.name: Control transformer
entries.summary: A control transformer supplies an auxiliary circuit at the specified voltage.

entries.name: Power-factor-correction capacitor bank

entries.name: Flexible busbar connection

entries.summary: A busbar assembly carries power through a defined set of conductors and supports.

entries.name: Busbar support insulator

entries.name: Single-bus single-breaker bay arrangement
entries.summary: Connects the assigned circuit through its breaker to one common bus.

entries.name: Sectionalised single-bus arrangement
entries.summary: Divides a common bus into identified sections with a defined section connection.

entries.name: Double-bus single-breaker bay arrangement
entries.summary: Provides the assigned bay with selected connection paths to two buses through one circuit breaker.

entries.name: Double-bus double-breaker bay arrangement
entries.summary: Provides separately switched breaker paths between the assigned circuit and two buses.

entries.name: Main-and-transfer bus arrangement
entries.summary: Provides the documented transfer-bus path used alongside the main bus connection.

entries.name: Breaker-and-a-half diameter arrangement
entries.summary: Connects two circuits through the documented three-breaker diameter between buses.

entries.name: Ring-bus circuit arrangement
entries.summary: Connects circuit takeoffs between adjacent switching devices in the documented bus ring.

entries.name: Mesh-corner circuit arrangement
entries.summary: Shows the assigned circuit connections around a documented mesh corner.

entries.name: Single-breaker bus-coupler arrangement
entries.summary: Connects the assigned bus sections through their defined coupler breaker path.

entries.name: Bus-section disconnector arrangement
entries.summary: Identifies the isolating connection separating the assigned bus conductor sections.

entries.name: Bus-transfer bypass arrangement
entries.summary: Shows the alternate path bypassing the assigned bay breaker under its documented configuration.
